camel_example: aliyun bssopenapi SetRenewal --region cn-hangzhou --ProductCode rds --RenewalStatus AutoRenewal --InstanceIDs 'rm-askjdhaskfjh'
description_zh: 调用SetRenewal为一个实例设置自动续费服务
kebab_example: aliyun bssopenapi set-renewal --instance-ids rm-askjdhaskfjh --product-code rds --renewal-status AutoRenewal --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetRenewal

parameters.help_en:
The auto-renewal period. Valid values:

1
2
3
6
12

This parameter is required if the RenewalStatus parameter is set to AutoRenewal
parameters.help_zh:
设置实例自动续费时长，取值：
1。
2。
3。
6。
12。

当RenewalStatus= AutoRenewal时，必须设置
parameters.name: renewal_period

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance. You can enable auto-renewal for up to 100 subscription instances at a time. Separate multiple instance IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID，支持批量设置最多100个包年包月实例，多个实例ID以英文逗号分隔
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en:
The billing method. Valid values:

Subscription: subscription
PayAsYouGo: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
订阅类型。取值：
Subscription：预付费。
PayAsYouGo：后付费
parameters.name: subscription_type

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the auto-renewal period. Valid values:

M: months
Y: years

This parameter is required if the RenewalStatus parameter is set to AutoRenewal
parameters.help_zh:
自动续费周期单位，取值：
M：月。
Y：年。

当RenewalStatus= AutoRenewal时，必须设置
parameters.name: renewal_period_unit

parameters.help_en:
The status of renewal. Valid values:

AutoRenewal: The instance is automatically renewed.
ManualRenewal: The instance is manually renewed.
NotRenewal: The instance is not renewed
parameters.help_zh:
续费状态，取值：
AutoRenewal：自动续费。
ManualRenewal：手动续费。
NotRenewal：不续费
parameters.name: renewal_status

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
